source_request: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보팩에 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.
interpreted_intent: Authorized independent random complex scene using the attached portrait appearance to test Cross-Color Lighting, Colored Rim Light, and Background Color Wash. Agent-selected scene is an overnight planetarium projectionist aligning a brass star projector; the three lighting concepts are independently interpreted as two differently colored lights meeting on the same subject, a colored contour light from behind, and colored illumination covering a background surface. Labels and scene are experiment-authored, not user definitions.
subject: An adult planetarium projectionist with the supplied portrait facial appearance and long dark wavy hair
setting: A closed planetarium with brass projector, control console, calibration plate and curved wall
event: The projectionist turns a focus knob while watching a constellation calibration
visual_priorities: Crossed colored lights, narrow colored rim and broad background color wash remain visibly distinct
baseline_prompt_en: Create a cinematic photographic portrait of an adult planetarium projectionist aligning a brass star projector after closing time. Preserve the supplied portrait reference's facial appearance, long dark wavy hair, and softly parted lips. She stands behind a waist-high control console, her right hand turning a large reachable focus knob while her left palm rests on the console edge; her shoulders remain level above planted feet. Her gaze follows a tiny sharp constellation projected onto a frosted calibration plate beside the mechanism. Show her from the hips upward in a three-quarter frontal view, with both forearms connected visibly to their hands and the brass projector offset beside her. Cyan light arriving from camera left and amber light arriving from camera right meet across the same face and black work blouse, retaining separate colored sides and a readable central transition. A narrow magenta light traces the outer hair and far shoulder from behind. An emerald light wash spreads broadly over the curved planetarium wall behind her, visibly separate from the colors on her body. The calibration stars remain small white points against the illuminated wall. Fine metal gears, a cream paper star chart, and a coiled instrument cable create a lived-in technical setting. Prioritize readable facial likeness and physically distinct colored illumination, with detailed skin and brass surfaces, restrained atmospheric haze, and cinematic photographic depth.
